image_description:
## 1) Chart type
- **Composite visualization** consisting of:
  - a **categorical scatter/dot plot** at the top
  - a **choropleth world map** at the bottom

## 2) Layout techniques
- **Vertical multi-panel layout**: dot plot above, map below.
- The top chart uses **grouping by categorical y-axis levels** (water stress categories), not faceting.
- No stacking or small multiples are used.
- The map uses a **continuous geographic layout** with color shading and point/text annotations for selected cities.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Urban population (millions) | Quantitative | Position on x-axis in the top dot plot |
| Water stress level | Ordinal | Position on y-axis in the top dot plot; color/hue in both top plot and map legend |
| Urban area / city name | Categorical/nominal | Individual dots in top plot; text labels and point locations for selected cities on the map |
| Geographic location | Spatial | Position on the world map |
| Area-level water stress | Ordinal | Color/hue of regions on the choropleth map |
| Data availability (“No data”) | Categorical/nominal | Gray fill on the map / legend swatch |

### Notes
- Selected cities are additionally emphasized with **outlined markers** and **labels**.
- Country/place names on the map are shown as **text labels**, but they function as annotations rather than a separate encoded data series.
